prerequisites: re-audit and hash exact pinned C# branch and full call graph
choose one nonempty branch and enumerate complete positive and negative semantic dependencies
define sufficient immutable summary/key including context and collision policy
specify current-compilation reconstruction and reporter/diagnostic/verifier preservation
run pinned adversarial differential experiment including a negative lookup becoming positive, context edits, ownership, diagnostics, bindings, cancellation/recovery and terminal verifier results

minimal_experiment.inputs: two adjacent revisions of one smallest candidate nonempty module; preserve candidate source in revision B while changing context so a previously absent lookup becomes present
assertions: candidate resolver-call counter decreases exactly at intended branch on HIT
every returned object reference belongs to current compilation
exact diagnostics, bindings/definition targets and terminal verifier outcomes match fresh baseline
each omitted-context mutation (imports/exports, shadowing, options, rewriter/plugin, cancellation/recovery) is rejected as MISS
minimal_experiment.evidence: archive source/input hashes, isolated-process traces and comparison results; a falsification experiment only, not a theorem
